"use server"
// PROBE — must turn tests/unit/agent-actions-error-codes.test.ts RED (catch).
// The code is fine; the catch swallows the cause with a console.error.
export async function probeAction() {
    try {
        await Promise.reject(new Error("boom"))
        return { success: true }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e)
        return { success: false, error: "ADD_POLICY_FAILED" }
    }
}
